name: CryptoKeyhole API
description:
On-chain and market analytics for Bitcoin, Ethereum and a growing list of coins, calculated from CryptoKeyhole's own nodes and collectors: every chart's history as exact values, the metric catalogue, the Fear & Greed Index, perpetual futures screens and an MCP server for AI assistants.

Without a key you read the Free view: the Free charts at daily, weekly, monthly and yearly resolution with full history, plus the free tools' endpoints. A chart above your plan answers a fixed historical sample or a plan lock, never a current reading. With an API key from your account page (Plus and higher plans) you read what your plan includes: Plus adds hourly data, the Plus charts and downloads; Pro adds ten-minute data, every premium chart and full-history downloads; API & Team adds commercial use and unmetered calls. Keys are read-only and go in the Authorization header. Each client (key or address) may make 240 requests a minute; Plus includes 1,000 API calls a day and Pro 100,000 a month.

Free charts and free API data are licensed CC BY 4.0 (credit CryptoKeyhole with a link); their answers, JSON and CSV, carry a Link header with rel="license". Paid-plan data, the samples of paid charts and raw exchange or other third-party data are not covered and carry no such header.

Times are UTC Unix seconds; a range's start is included and its end is not. Values are exact decimal strings (null where there is no observation, never zero), each with its finality: final, provisional, or partial for the open period, which is updated hourly until it closes.
